text:
Alisha: quick heads-up — our weekly pulse shows webinar conversion down 18% QoQ for EMEA. not a huge sample but spikes in drop happened right after Tues launch post. :thinking:
Marco: saw that. could be inbound routing tests we flipped on Mon (splitting EU leads to new SFDC flow). @Devon do we have counts by route?
Devon: pulling them now. one quick note — attribution window changed from 7d->3d last week for a/b experiments which shrinks 'first touch' counts. that could explain part.
Sanja: fwiw the messaging variants we rolled into the post had reduced CTA prominence (two CTAs vs one). could be UX friction.
Olivia: here's the dashboard link: https://looker.redwood.com/dashboards/pulse/launch_benchmarks — look at cohort filters: region=EMEA, source=organic|paid, wks=last4
Priya: thanks. initial check: organic webinar signups dropped 22% in FR/DE, paid stable. sounds like routing + copy.
Alisha: ok timeline: Mon routing flip + Tues post copy -> drop by Wed. can we isolate routing impact by comparing routed vs fallback pool?
Devon: quick SQL snippet I ran:
```
SELECT routed_flow, COUNT(*) AS leads
FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01' AND region = 'EMEA'
GROUP BY routed_flow;
```
routed_flow shows 2.3k -> new_flow 1.9k, old_flow fallback 400 — so volume shifted but conversions per flow differ.
Marco: interesting — new_flow has stricter validation so leads are dropping earlier. that would lower conversion to webinar because fewer leads reach nurture.
Sanja: hypothesis: messaging + routing validation combo -> fewer nurtured leads -> dashboard conversion drop. propose: revert validation for a 3-day A/B and push single-CTA post variant to FR/DE.
Alisha: agreed. can we make a small playbook: 1) revert validation toggle at 10:00 UTC tomorrow, 2) swap post creative to single CTA, 3) run 3-day window and compare conversion & CPL.
Priya: I'll coordinate creative swap and update content in the CMS. tagging @Olivia for dashboard refresh and weekly KPI slide updates.
Olivia: will add a micro-segment card to the KPI slide: 'EMEA routed vs fallback', and add time-decay attribution lines (3d vs 7d) so we can see delta.
growth-bot: weekly-metrics: total leads 9,742 (-2.1%); webinar signups 1,102 (-8.3%); CPL $78 (+12%). Full report posted to #marketing-reports. :pager:
Alisha: thanks team — let's regroup Fri 09:30 for quick readout. keep notes in this thread and drop any raw queries. :thumbsup:
